## D30 — Architecture design method

Section: [system-design-exercises](../system-design-exercises/index.md) · 2/2 topic entries have a page

| ID | Topic | Status | Page | Inventory (from the master curriculum) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| D30-T01 | Architecture design method | :material-circle-slice-5: Draft | [design-method](../system-design-exercises/design-method.md) | Design method sequence: (1) Understand the business problem, users, stakeholders, and outcome. → (2) Gather functional requirements, NFRs, assumptions, constraints, and risks. → (3) Estimate users, requests/second, concurrency, storage, bandwidth, growth, and peak load. → (4) Define system boundaries, domains, services, and responsibilities. → (5) Design APIs, events, protocols, and integration contracts. → (6) Design data models, databases, storage, replication, indexes, and caching. → (7) Select the architecture style and explain why. → (8) Design compute, network, cloud services, regions, and deployment. → (9) Define identity, authorization, encryption, secrets, and trust boundaries. → (10) Design scaling, resilience, failover, DR, and performance. → (11) Design CI/CD, IaC, observability, support, and operations. → (12) Estimate costs, document trade-offs, validate assumptions, and record ADRs. |
| D30-T02 | AI system design decisions | :material-circle-slice-2: Outline | [design-method](../system-design-exercises/design-method.md) | For AI systems, additionally decide on model selection, managed vs self-hosted, RAG vs fine-tuning, retrieval/data permissions, agent autonomy and approvals, tool permissions, evaluation, safety/guardrails, inference capacity, model fallback, and AI cost controls. |
